name: Leia
source:
Despite being a woman, she has an outstanding talent which let her become the youngest head of the royal guards in history. She is tasked with guarding the princess.
She has a very serious personality and obeys orders unconditionally.
She is deeply trusted by the princess, who occasionally consults with her.
